title: Newton-Cartan limit of Klein-Gordon AQFT: gravitational atoms and the loss of vacuum entanglement
summary: We take the non-relativistic limit $c\to\infty$ of the free Klein-Gordon field on static spacetimes at three levels: one-particle resolvents, quasi-free states and the time-zero net. After subtraction of the rest energy, the one-particle Hamiltonian is an explicit function of a Schrödinger-type operator whose potential on the Schwarzschild exterior is exactly Newtonian. On regular static stars it converges to the Newtonian Schrödinger operator in norm-resolvent sense at rate $c^{-2}$, with convergence of eigenvalues and an explicit first post-Newtonian correction.
